requirements.text: The system shall maintain records of external organizations classified as either Customers, Vendors, or Shippers.
The system shall maintain the hierarchical relationship where Customers, Vendors, and Shippers are separate entities inheriting from Companies.
The system shall record Company information including name, phone number, address details, state, zip code and website.
The system shall assign each Company to exactly one company type.
The system shall associate each company with exactly one geographic state.
The system shall assign a standard Tax Status to each company.
The system shall allow multiple Contacts to be associated with a single company.
The system shall maintain Contacts including first name, last name, primary and secondary phone numbers, email address, job title, and notes for each company contact.
The system shall maintain Employee records with personal information (first and last name, primary/secondary phone numbers) and professional information (job title, email).
The system shall assign exactly one Title to each employee.
The system shall support a hierarchical reporting structure where employees may report to one supervisor.
The system shall allow one supervisor to manage multiple Employees.
The system shall allow Employees to be assigned multiple privileges.
The system shall maintain a Product catalog with product codes, names, descriptions, and pricing information.
The system shall assign each product to exactly one Product Category.
The system shall track standard unit cost and retail unit price for each product.
The system shall monitor inventory levels including reorder level, target level, and minimum reorder quantity for each product.
The system shall support marking products as discontinued.
The system shall maintain Product Categories with names, codes, descriptions, and optional images.
The system shall allow multiple Products to be supplied by multiple Vendors.
The system shall support periodic Stock Takes to record and verify product inventory.
The system shall record Stock Take information including date, product, quantity on hand, and expected quantity.
The system shall calculate inventory discrepancies between expected and actual counts.
The system shall record Customer Orders with dates, customer information, and shipping details.
The system shall enforce that each Order must be associated with exactly one Customer.
The system shall assign each Order to exactly one Employee who processes it.
The system shall track the Order Status using predefined order status values.
The system shall assign exactly one Shipper to each Order.
The system shall calculate and record tax information including tax rate and Tax Status for each order.
The system shall record invoice date, payment method, and payment date for financial reconciliation.
The system shall require each Order to contain one or more Order Detail items.
The system shall track product, quantity, unit price, and discount for each Order Detail item.
The system shall assign a Status to each Order Detail item using predefined status values.
The system shall manage Purchase Orders for acquiring products from Vendors.
The system shall enforce that each Purchase Order must be associated with exactly one Vendor.
The system shall record which Employee submitted each Purchase Order.
The system shall record which Employee approved each Purchase Order.
The system shall track the status of each Purchase Order using predefined Purchase Order Status values.
The system shall record the order date for each Purchase Order.
The system shall require each Purchase Order to contain one or more Purchase Order Detail items.
The system shall track product, quantity, and unit price for each Purchase Order Detail item.
The system shall record which Employee added each record and when it was added.
The system shall record which Employee last modified each record and when it was modified.
